response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS diff_from_mean_of_averages FROM t;

assumptions.assumption: The ratio is spent/amount per budget line. A line with amount = 0 (or NULL spent or amount) gives a NULL ratio, which AVG ignores. Lines with spent = 0 are kept and count as a ratio of 0.
The difference is signed (type average minus the unweighted mean of the per-type averages). That mean is taken over types that have a non-NULL average.

alternatives.interpretation: 'How far' read as an absolute distance, with no sign.
alternatives.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_ratio, ABS(avg_ratio - AVG(avg_ratio) OVER ()) AS diff_from_mean_of_averages FROM t;
